class.name: SteamDedicatedServer
class.brief_description: Scoped observation of one exact Steam dedicated Game attachment.

method.name: status
method.description: Read a detached readiness, advertisement, world and authenticated player count snapshot. A retired attachment returns idle status.

method.name: get_initialization_error
method.description: Read the safe diagnostic captured during native setup. An empty string means setup started without an immediate error.

method.name: inventory_verifier
method.description: Return the verifier for the exact dedicated attachment. It validates Steam inventory proofs only for the current transport-certified and admitted identity. After teardown it reports unavailable.

method.name: stats
method.description: Resolve Steam progression for the currently admitted remote connection with [param peer_id]. Returns null for the local authority, unknown or retired peers, a Game outside its dedicated Steam session, or calls off the scene thread. The returned service is bound to this exact authenticated admission.

signal.name: status_changed
signal.description: Emitted on the scene thread when one public status field changes, including on retirement.
